_note: R5: words that turn a festival with religious or identity roots into a mere drinking spree. The calendar lists parties (2026-11-09), so «party» and «rumba» are fine; what a person must read is a text about getting drunk where devotion or identity is part of the fiesta. A hit in a name, street_tip or etiquette text sends it to a person (onboarding flags it in the PR; build-data warns). Matching ignores case and accents and needs whole words.
